cardsPage.lockedPanelTitle: Want to see the full deck?

companyDashboard.title: Company dashboard
companyDashboard.subtitle: Your culture at a glance.
companyDashboard.recognitionRateInfo: Active employees and managers who received at least one recognition in the latest 30 days divided by active employees and managers.
companyDashboard.sparklineLabel: Recognition trend over the latest 30 days
companyDashboard.employeesDefinition: Active employees and managers, excluding admins
companyDashboard.categoryDistributionCopy: Communication, Creativity, Competence, and Collegiality are shown clearly for company-wide recognition.
companyDashboard.recognitionActivityChartLabel: Recognition activity over the latest six months
companyDashboard.emptyCategoryCopy: Once employees start claiming cards, this panel will show which strengths are showing up most across the company.
companyDashboard.emptyQualitiesCopy: As recognitions come in, the qualities most celebrated across your company will surface here automatically.
companyDashboard.emptyTrendCopy: Monthly momentum will appear here after recognitions begin flowing through your company.
companyDashboard.teamComparisonWaiting: Teams are loaded. Recognition totals will fill in as activity is claimed.
companyDashboard.emptyTeamsCopy: Once your company has teams assigned, this panel will compare recognition activity across them.

home.description: Turn everyday appreciation into visible employee strengths and actionable culture insights. GETH combines physical recognition cards with personal dashboards and organisational insights, helping employees feel valued and companies understand what makes their people thrive.
home.deckPreviewTitle: See how recognition comes to life.
home.deckPreviewCopy: Preview a few cards from our impact categories.
home.previewListeningCopy: You give people space to speak openly, without judgment. Your attention makes the difference.
home.previewRenewingCopy: You bring fresh ideas and new perspectives that help others grow and see new possibilities.
home.previewGoalOrientedCopy: You set clear goals, make plans, and bring them to life step by step.
home.previewCaringCopy: You pay attention to colleagues and contribute to a positive, safe, and engaged work environment.
home.howCopy: Recognition becomes visible in five simple steps.
home.step1Copy: Choose a card that fits what you want to express.
home.step2Copy: Give the card to someone and share why this matters to you.
home.step3Title: The receiver scans the QR code
home.step3Copy: The receiver scans the QR code to record the compliment digitally and grow their profile.
home.step4Copy: Appreciation becomes visible in the personal profile and in the team overview.
home.step5Copy: More appreciation creates more connection, energy and growth.
home.companiesCopy: Build a culture of recognition that drives engagement, retention, and measurable impact.
home.managersCopy: Spot what matters, celebrate often, and lead with data that helps your team thrive.
home.employeesCopy: Feel valued, energized, and connected through everyday recognition.
home.ctaEyebrow: Ready to build a recognition culture?
home.ctaTitle: Make recognition visible, measurable, and beautifully human.

resourcesPage.title: How can we help?
resourcesPage.copy: Contact the GETH support team for rollout questions, account help, card claiming, QR scanning, or dashboard guidance.
resourcesPage.supportCopy: Send us your question and we will help you get the right next step.
resourcesPage.formCopy: Use the form to prepare your message, then choose email or live WhatsApp chat.
resourcesPage.replyTime: We usually reply within one business day.
resourcesPage.successCopy: Your email app should open with the prepared message.
resourcesPage.failureTitle: We could not open the support channel.
resourcesPage.failureCopy: Please use the direct email link instead:
resourcesPage.whatsappHint: For urgent support, start a live WhatsApp chat with the GETH team at +31 6 1379 5467.
resourcesPage.whatsappUnavailable: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP_NUMBER to enable WhatsApp support.

companyBilling.configurationCopy: Company admins can download issued invoices here.
companyBilling.generatedInvoicesCopy: Download official GETH invoice PDFs with invoice number, VAT, due date, and payment reference.
companyBilling.emptyCopy: Issued invoices will appear here when they are available for download.

messages.checkoutSuccess: Checkout completed. Billing will update your subscription status shortly.
messages.checkoutCancelled: Checkout was cancelled. You can restart it anytime.
messages.stripeNotConfigured: Card checkout is not configured. Invoice access remains available.
messages.priceNotConfigured: This plan needs a price configuration before checkout can start.
messages.checkoutFailed: Checkout could not create a session. Check billing configuration.
messages.invoiceGenerated: Invoice generated and emailed successfully. You can also download it from the invoice list below.
messages.invoiceGeneratedEmailFailed: Invoice generated, but email delivery failed. Download the PDF below and check SMTP/get.pro settings.
messages.invoiceGenerationFailed: Invoice request was saved, but the invoice document could not be generated. Please contact platform support.
messages.invoiceConfigMissing: Invoice generation is blocked until seller and payment account details are configured in environment variables.
messages.invoiceRequestFailed: Invoice request could not be saved. Please check the billing details and try again.
messages.invoiceNotEnabled: Invoice payments are not enabled for this plan.
